summary: Iteration 94: end-to-end test of storefront -> console -> rider app -> customer space, using 2 riders (rider1 Kouamé Serge, rider2 Yao Franck), 6 orders from one TEST_ customer (plus 12 left over from 3 earlier runs, all removed). Backend: new pytest test_e2e_rider_flow_iter94.py, 22 of 26 pass. The 4 failures are real bugs. UI checked at 390x844 for the rider app and 1920x1080 for the console. ROOT-CAUSE FIX VERIFIED: rider1 now sees 18 open courses (was 0) and rider2 sees 13. Results per scenario: S1 PARTIAL (the order shows in console Commandes with full details, but the Gérante gets no in-app notification for orders waiting for a deposit, and every order of 28-36k FCFA needs one); S2 OK (deposit guard works; 'prete' is blocked without a scan; wrong code is rejected and the right code is accepted; assign works through both the delivery day and /deliveries/assign; assigned_at is set; the rider list updates within 6-10 s without reload; notification link /riders?course=CODE opens the course in the UI; rider security returns 403/404 as expected); S3 PARTIAL (Je démarre creates delivery_code and a WhatsApp outbox entry with kind delivery_code; a wrong code gives 401 and the right code delivers in API and UI; console shows Livrée; customer space shows Livrée; BUT the customer gets no 'livrée' notification); S4 PARTIAL (postpone: console has the new date, the reason and the session postponed_to, and the rider sees it read-only as Reportée, BUT console and customer both show 'À préparer' instead of Reportée and the customer never sees the new date; failure: console shows Échec plus the reason and the customer gets a 'non livrée' notification, BUT the échouée order is missing from the customer order list); S5 OK (store<->customer, store<->rider and customer<->rider threads all deliver messages, with notifications and correct links on every side); S6 PARTIAL (delivery-day reconcile needs the PIN and collected_total is right, BUT rider COD money never reaches the Gérante cash session, and the amount to collect ignores the deposit already paid); S7 OK (offline delivery in the UI queues 1 action with banner 'Hors ligne · 1 action en attente'; on reconnect POST /rider/sync runs; the order becomes livree with proof.offline=true, timeline offline=true and delivered_at = offline time; replay is idempotent; customer space shows Livrée).

critical.endpoint: GET /api/riders/me/today, rider Courses UI, delivery-sessions total_to_collect/collected_total, reconcile due, WhatsApp 'Préparez X FCFA'
critical.issue: The amount to collect is always o.total, even when a deposit was paid (deposit_paid). Example: DN-261018-1987 total 30 000, deposit 9 000 paid, but the rider UI says 'À encaisser 30 000 FCFA', the proof amount is prefilled with 30 000 and the console day shows 92 000 instead of 64 400. The rider will over-collect from the customer.

deliver_order never calls order_status_event, so the customer gets no 'Votre commande est livrée' notification (only the WhatsApp outbox entry is made). It also does not set delivered_at for online deliveries, and payment_status is not set to paye.

_IN_PROGRESS_STATUSES=(nouvelle,confirmee,assignee,en_preparation,en_livraison,reportee) and _CANCELLED=(annulee,retournee,refusee) leave out 'echouee', 'prete' and 'en_attente_acompte'. The failed order DN-261018-2472 and all orders waiting for a deposit are missing from the customer's 'Mes commandes' list (the detail page only opens by direct URL).

Rider COD collections never reach the Gérante cash session. Reconcile writes only delivery_sessions.reconciliations (no cash_movement), and cash-session close counts only orders with payment_method=='cash'. Scenario 6 (amounts in the Gérante cash session) is not implemented.

minor.issue: The staff bell lists only orders with status 'nouvelle'. Storefront orders created as 'en_attente_acompte' (deposit policy, every order >= threshold) get no in-app staff notification; they only get a web push via notify_staff, which is not stored.

The customer is notified only for en route, reportée, non livrée and annulée. No notification for confirmée (mark-deposit-paid does not emit an event), en préparation, prête (status-v3 does not call order_status_event) or assignée (assign_delivery and session_add_order do not call it).

The status is reset to 'confirmee'. Console and customer then show 'À préparer' with a 'Préparer' action, although the order was already scanned and prepared. The customer detail never shows the new delivery date (2026-10-19).

Does not add the order to the new rider's delivery day or remove it from the previous rider's day (session_id is kept). Orders assigned this way, e.g. DN-261018-2472 for rider2, are missing from the evening reconciliation, and a reassigned order stays counted in the old rider's day.

The access_token cookie wins over the Authorization header. The console and the rider app share one cookie on the same origin, so logging in as a rider in a browser replaces the console session, and the reverse.

Allows delivering from 'assignee' without the en_livraison step. It then fails with 'Code requis/invalide' because delivery_code is created only at en_livraison, which is fine in practice, but the photo method bypasses the start step.

ui_bugs.issue: 'À encaisser' and the proof-amount prefill use order.total and ignore deposit_paid
Échouée and en_attente_acompte orders are not listed; a postponed order shows 'À préparer' and no new date

integration_issues.issue: The badge shows 'À préparer' plus the Préparer CTA instead of Reportée / new date (the date appears only in the Livraison card)

issues: Native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) used instead of the shadcn calendar

action_items: Compute the amount due as total - deposit_paid (and minus wallet_used if relevant) everywhere: rider_today to_collect plus a per-order amount_due field, Courses.jsx 'À encaisser' and the proof prefill, delivery-sessions totals, reconcile due, and the WhatsApp assignee/en_livraison text
Call order_status_event (customer and staff) in deliver_order, set delivered_at and payment_status there, and do the same for the offline path
Add 'echouee', 'prete' and 'en_attente_acompte' to the orders-split buckets (in_progress or a 'non livrée' bucket)
Bring reconciled rider COD amounts into the Gérante cash session (cash_movement on reconcile, or include delivery-session collections in the expected amount and show them in CashSessions.jsx)
Show postponed orders as 'Reportée au JJ/MM' in console and customer space, with no re-prepare CTA when prep_scan already exists
Store an in-app staff notification for every new storefront order, including en_attente_acompte
Emit customer notifications for confirmée (mark-deposit-paid), prête (status-v3) and assignée (assign endpoints)
Make /deliveries/{oid}/assign attach the order to the rider's delivery day of that date, or document that only delivery days are reconciled

Update stale regression tests: test_rider_notifications.py expects '/rider?course=' and '/rider/messages' (now '/riders...'); test_rider_v2.py delivers orders not assigned to the rider (now correctly 403)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5878 lines and has two status endpoints (/orders/{oid}/status and /status-v3) with different side effects: only the first emits notifications and WhatsApp messages, only v3 sets delivered_at and the invoice. Unify them into one transition service.
rider_today runs an $or with a 'timeline.at >= start' branch on unindexed fields; it will slow down as orders grow. Add indexes on rider_id + status and postponed_rider_id.
suggest_split and create_session use the UTC date while rider_today uses Africa/Abidjan. Same day today (UTC+0), but inconsistent.
get_user prefers the cookie over the Bearer header.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (rider list, deep link, notification click, Je démarre, Livrée with code, offline queue and sync, console list/detail, delivery days OK; customer list misses échouée orders; amounts ignore deposit)

seed_data_creation: Created customers 'TEST_E2E Cliente94' (5 accounts, 3 of them from accidental xdist and early runs) with 18 orders, 2 delivery sessions for 2026-10-18 (rider1, rider2), conversations, notifications and WhatsApp outbox rows. ALL DELETED by cleanup_iter94.py, and stock was restored. Left behind: a manager (Fatou Konaté) attendance arrival check-in for 2026-10-18 with a dummy selfie, plus 1 rider_sync_ops row for rider1 from the UI offline test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the e2e file with: pytest test_e2e_rider_flow_iter94.py -n 0 -p no:randomly (it MUST run serially; xdist breaks shared state). The deposit policy applies to COD orders >= threshold (30%), so orders start as en_attente_acompte; confirm them with POST /orders/{oid}/mark-deposit-paid {tx_ref}. Prep: GET /orders/{oid}/prep gives expected_code; then POST prep/verify and PATCH /status-v3 prete. Rider UI login: button 'Se connecter avec e-mail et mot de passe', then [data-testid=rider-login-email] + password + Enter. Delivery code is in orders.delivery_code (DB) or the WhatsApp outbox. Do not mix a Bearer admin token with a rider cookie in the same Playwright context (the cookie wins). After the test run: python tests/cleanup_iter94.py.
rca of the issue: Amount to collect: rider_today, list_sessions and reconcile all use o['total'], which still includes the deposit already paid by Wave (deposit_paid is never subtracted). Missing 'livrée' customer notification: deliver_order (server.py ~L797) writes status 'livree' directly and calls only _enqueue_wa and wallet, never routers.notify.order_status_event. Customer list gaps: _IN_PROGRESS_STATUSES/_CANCELLED_STATUSES (server.py L397-398) do not cover echouee, prete or en_attente_acompte. Cash session: close_cash_session sums only payment_method=='cash' orders, and reconcile creates no cash_movements.
